about.title: About Infurnish - Thoughtful Furniture for Modern Living
about.html:
Our Philosophy

Furniture as an Extension
of Peaceful Living

Founded with a devotion to quiet elegance and natural materials, Infurnish creates timeless architectural pieces that anchor your home in warmth and enduring calm.

🪵

Solid Hardwood & Ethical Sourcing

Every oak, walnut, and ash timber is responsibly harvested from certified forests, celebrating the natural grain and knot variations.

🔨

Traditional Joinery, Modern Rigor

Mortise-and-tenon joints, dovetailed corners, and minimal hardware ensure each piece endures for generations.

🌿

Warm & Calming Palette

We curate tactile linens, hand-woven rattan, and brushed stone that reflect soft ambient light and create peaceful sanctuaries.

✨

Direct-to-Customer Integrity

By eliminating distributor markups, we deliver museum-grade craftsmanship at honest, transparent prices.

Our Vision

To become the most trusted name in modern home furnishing by making beautiful, lasting furniture accessible to everyone.

Our Mision
